name: EOS 欢乐谷(Happy Pool)
rootCause: Hackers launched continuous attacks on the EOS quiz game EOS Happy Valley, and they have profited hundreds of EOS. The game party has transferred the account balance away. Attackers still use transaction crowding out attacks. To completely fix this vulnerability, DApp developers should remove controllable variables such as account balance or time factors to participate in random number generation.
